# EasyFix brand assets — generated, do not hand-edit

**Source:** `EasyFix-Brand-Kit/apps/crm/` (generated by the kit's `build/build.js`)
**Copied:** 2026-08-18
**Copied into:** `public/brand/` (SVG set) and `public/` (web icon/favicon set)

These files are **build output**, not source. Do not hand-edit anything in this
directory — any manual tweak is silently lost the next time the kit is rebuilt.
To change a mark, colour, or lockup, edit the brand kit and re-run
`build/build.js`, then re-copy `apps/crm/svg/` → `public/brand/` and
`apps/crm/web/` → `public/`.

## Colour-variant gotcha (read this before picking a file)

**Unsuffixed SVGs are RED (`#c42430`), not `currentColor`.**

| Suffix | Fill | Use when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| *(none)*, `-red` | `#c42430` (brand red), identical files | you want the brand red regardless of context |
| `-currentcolor` | `currentColor` — inherits CSS `color` | you want the mark to take the surrounding text colour |
| `-onlight` | tuned for light backgrounds | light UI surfaces |
| `-ondark` | tuned for dark backgrounds | dark UI surfaces |
| `-white` | white | over photography / solid brand-red fills |
| `-ink` | ink/near-black | mono print, greyscale contexts |

Earlier revisions of the kit shipped the *unsuffixed* files as `currentColor`,
which made them render blank when opened directly in a browser or dropped into a
context with no inherited `color`. That was fixed by making unsuffixed = red and
moving the inheriting variant to an explicit `-currentcolor` suffix. If you
reach for the "default" file expecting it to inherit colour, you will get red.

## Aspect ratios (viewBox)

| Asset family | viewBox |
| --- | --- |
| `logo-tagline-*` | `0 0 1000 315.361` |
| `logo-horizontal-*` | `0 0 1000 242.542` |
| `logo-vertical-*` | `0 0 1000 1133.809` |
| `wordmark-*` | `0 0 1000 196.327` |
| `mark*` | `0 0 1000 876` |
| `icon-*`, `adaptive-*`, `favicon.svg`, `notification.svg` | `0 0 1024 1024` |

## Fonts

IBM Plex Sans (weights 400/500/600 only — the identity doc permits no others)
lives in `src/app/fonts/` as woff2, converted from the kit's
`build/fonts/*.ttf`. IBM Plex is OFL-licensed; the licence ships alongside the
fonts at `src/app/fonts/OFL.txt` and must not be removed.

IBM Plex Sans Devanagari is deliberately **not** bundled — the CRM is
staff-facing and English-only.
